title: Generalize Raster Surface Kind to Paint2d
description: Rename the framework SurfaceKind::Raster variant (wire "raster") to SurfaceKind::Paint2d (wire "paint-2d"), and RasterScene -> Paint2dScene, across ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx + its raster-host.tsx (renamed to paint-2d-host.tsx), framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs native renderer, and the owning raster/plugin/rs/lib.rs call sites. This is a framework-purity fix: the generic SurfaceKind enum must not encode app identity. Update the UiComponentSceneNode field raster -> paint_2d (JSON "paint2d") to match the existing per-surface-kind field naming convention. Inline test updates in framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts. Flag anything that can't be cleanly generalized (e.g. os-shell.tsx's createRasterSession directly importing the raster app's own WASM package into framework/renderer/react) for later architecture audit. Part of a sequential wave of surface-generalization tickets under GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES (parent ticket not yet materialized at ticket_open time).
